subject: frame_bench BASELINE (host replay + device model) - run: python3 gpu/tools/frame_bench.py
body: Baseline HEAD 434e11d + 15 dirty gpu files (git status in history.jsonl). Command: python3 gpu/tools/frame_bench.py [--scenario N] [--what-if clock_mhz=886,wait_ms=0.02,async_wait=1,encode_scale=0.05,jobs_scale=0.5] [--rebaseline]; ~10 s, lock-guarded, nice 10, one clang TU (cached on hash of all inputs). Device model (c6jb, 33 windows): gpu_ms = 5.75*fs_job+3.39*other_job R2 .99 LOO 7%; encode = 6.45 ms/draw (n=4 clean windows, LOO 6%). Host replay (steady, batched = c6jb config): tick 5 draws/4 kjobs, small 18/12, medium 45/27, large 104/46, ca200 200/21 (per-draw 212), blur_heavy 58/14. Device-observed kjobs/cmd: small 15, medium 26, large 68. Predicted device frame ms serial (fps serial/pipelined): tick 56 (17.8/30), small 182 (5.5/8.8), medium 437 (2.3/3.5), large 910 (1.1/1.5), ca200 1357 (0.7/0.8). KEY: host encode is a constant 290k user instructions per draw in every shape (= SHA-NI over the 593 KB fixed_frag SPIR-V); device commit-create wall is a constant ~6.5 ms/draw -> strong candidate for the per-draw SHA-256, to be confirmed by TEGU_PERF_ENCODE plan/variant_ms on the next device run. With encode x0.05: medium 46 ms (21.6/31.4), small 21, tick 7; plus P3+654+async+preload: medium 38 (26/43), large 73; 886: medium 30 ms (32.8/62.7 pipelined). Host variant compile (first use) 27 ms/pipeline host cpu, 137M instr. Leak check: peak 28 MB flat across frames.
